items.title_en: France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks
items.title_zh: 法國指控伊朗發動網路破壞，攻擊冷凍設備
items.summary_en: France stated that Iranian hackers controlled fridge systems at 700 retail stores last month. They raised the temperatures at night, which ruined millions of dollars of food.
items.summary_zh: 法國指出，伊朗駭客上個月控制了 700 個零售據點的冷凍系統。他們在夜間調高溫度，導致價值數百萬美元的食物腐敗。
items.why_important_en: Cyberattacks can damage real-world equipment and cause big economic losses for businesses.
items.why_important_zh: 網路攻擊可能會破壞現實世界中的設備，並給企業帶來巨大的經濟損失。

vocab.definition_en: to say that someone has done something wrong
vocab.sentence_en: She accused her coworker of taking her notebook.
vocab.sentence_zh: 她指責同事拿了她的筆記本。

vocab.definition_en: relating to selling goods directly to consumers
vocab.sentence_en: The retail price of this jacket is too high.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這件外套的零售價格太高了。

vocab.definition_en: to become bad or unplayable to eat
vocab.sentence_en: Milk will spoil quickly if you leave it out of the fridge.
vocab.sentence_zh: 如果你把牛奶放在冰箱外，它會很快變質。

items.title_en: Supreme Court says border wall construction can continue in west Texas
items.title_zh: 最高法院表示西德州的邊境牆建設可以繼續進行
items.summary_en: The Supreme Court allowed border wall construction in west Texas to keep going. The Trump administration asked the court for emergency permission during an ongoing lawsuit.
items.summary_zh: 最高法院允許西德州的邊境牆建設繼續進行。川普政府在一項訴訟進行期間向法院申請了緊急許可。
items.why_important_en: Legal rulings can directly affect major government projects and border policies.
items.why_important_zh: 法律裁決可以直接影響政府的大型計畫與邊境政策。

vocab.definition_en: the act or process of building something
vocab.sentence_en: The new office building is currently under construction.
vocab.sentence_zh: 新的辦公大樓目前正在施工中。

vocab.definition_en: an act of asking formally for something
vocab.sentence_en: Please send your request for vacation days by Friday.
vocab.sentence_zh: 請在星期五之前送出您的休假申請。

vocab.definition_en: a legal claim brought to a court
vocab.sentence_en: The company faced a lawsuit over unpaid bills.
vocab.sentence_zh: 該公司因未付帳款而面臨訴訟。

items.title_en: British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault
items.title_zh: 英國喜劇演員羅素布蘭德因性侵及侵害罪被判處 10 年以上有期徒刑
items.summary_en: British comedian Russell Brand was sentenced to over 10 years in prison. A court found him guilty of sexual crimes after six women brought a case against him.
items.summary_zh: 英國喜劇演員羅素布蘭德被判處 10 年以上有期徒刑。在六名女性提告後，法院判定他性犯罪成立。
items.why_important_en: High-profile legal cases show that celebrities can also face severe consequences for breaking the law.
items.why_important_zh: 矚目的法律案件顯示，知名人士若違法同樣會面臨嚴重的法律後果。

vocab.definition_en: to state officially in court what someone's punishment will be
vocab.sentence_en: The judge will sentence the criminal next week.
vocab.sentence_zh: 法官將於下週對罪犯進行判刑。

vocab.definition_en: a famous person, especially in entertainment
vocab.sentence_en: Many celebrities attended the charity dinner last night.
vocab.sentence_zh: 許多名人昨晚出席了慈善晚宴。

vocab.definition_en: responsible for breaking a law or rule
vocab.sentence_en: He felt guilty for missing his friend's birthday party.
vocab.sentence_zh: 他因為錯過朋友的生日派對而感到內疚。

items.title_en: Qantas to cut 850 Australian jobs and outsource work to India under AI-driven overhaul
items.title_zh: 澳洲航空因應 AI 轉型將裁減 850 個在地職位，並將工作外包至印度
items.summary_en: Qantas will cut 850 jobs in Australia and move some work to India. The airline is changing its business by using artificial intelligence. This is part of a larger trend of job cuts in major Australian companies.
items.summary_zh: 澳洲航空將在澳洲裁減 850 個職位，並將部分工作轉移至印度。該航空公司正透過人工智慧進行業務轉型。這是澳洲大型企業裁員趨勢的一部分。
items.why_important_en: Artificial intelligence is changing how companies operate, leading to job losses and corporate changes.
items.why_important_zh: 人工智慧正在改變企業的營運方式，導致工作機會減少與企業重組。

vocab.definition_en: to pay another company to do work for your business
vocab.sentence_en: Our company decided to outsource customer service to reduce costs.
vocab.sentence_zh: 我們公司決定將客戶服務外包以降低成本。

vocab.definition_en: a disturbance that interrupts an event or process
vocab.sentence_en: Bad weather caused major disruption to the flight schedules.
vocab.sentence_zh: 惡劣天氣對航班日程造成了嚴重干擾。

vocab.definition_en: relating to a large business or company
vocab.sentence_en: She has worked in the corporate world for over ten years.
vocab.sentence_zh: 她在大企業領域工作了十多年。

items.title_en: What do we know about Nvidia CEO’s affair with a suspected Chinese spy?
items.title_zh: 關於輝達執行長與疑似中國間諜的外遇事件，我們了解多少？
items.summary_en: People are talking about news regarding Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang and an affair with a suspected spy. He was very popular among supporters, but this news may hurt his public image.
items.summary_zh: 人們正在討論關於輝達執行長黃仁勳與疑似間諜外遇的新聞。他先前非常受支持者歡迎，但這則新聞可能會損害他的公眾形象。
items.why_important_en: Personal scandals of top tech executives can affect public trust and company reputation.
items.why_important_zh: 頂尖科技高管的個人醜聞會影響公眾信任度與公司聲譽。

vocab.definition_en: thought to be guilty of something without proof
vocab.sentence_en: Police questioned a suspected shoplifter outside the store.
vocab.sentence_zh: 警方在店外詢問了一名涉嫌偷竊的人。

vocab.definition_en: the opinion that people have about someone or something
vocab.sentence_en: The restaurant has a good reputation for fresh seafood.
vocab.sentence_zh: 這家餐廳在新鮮海鮮方面擁有良好的聲譽。

vocab.definition_en: to continue to live or exist despite difficulties
vocab.sentence_en: Small businesses struggled to survive during the hard economic times.
vocab.sentence_zh: 在經濟困難時期，小企業努力求生存。
